# Choreia-local video_player 2.11.1

This package copies the published `video_player` 2.11.1 Dart package (pub.dev
archive SHA-256 `48a7bdaa38a3d50ec10c78627abdbfad863fdf6f0d6e08c7c3c040cfd80ae36f`).
The original `lib/video_player.dart` SHA-256 is
`05489dcc7a66588879cdb7f5207a8324203ed9afb91b423fd005b8cba4f6bc25`.
Only its controller startup Future ownership and disposal ordering differ.
The published `LICENSE` is included. Native platform implementation packages
retain the versions selected by the app lockfile.

The local pin is limited to Choreia. Keep its regression test in
`test/video_player_startup_future_test.dart` when updating this package.
